title: AttnGCG: Enhancing Jailbreaking Attacks on LLMs with Attention Manipulation
reasoning: The paper focuses on adversarial jailbreaking attacks and security vulnerabilities within LLMs (specifically Greedy Coordinate Gradient). While it mentions safety and ethical alignment as targets for the attack, the research is centered on the technical methodology of attention manipulation rather than benchmarking religion, morals, or ethical frameworks themselves.
